description: PAID over x402 inside this tool call (USDC on Base or Arc, $0.03 per lead returned, flat, with or without an email; default 3 leads = $0.09; set sample=true for 3 free leads first; the PaymentRequired quotes the exact total; no leads, no charge): local businesses by category and place with a graded email (A/B/C), a contact name when the email shows one, phone, website, socials and buying signals (no website, booking tool, payment system, hiring). Call once without payment to get the x402 PaymentRequired, then call again with the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

booking.description: Online booking tool: yes, none, vagaro, square_appointments, calendly, booksy, mindbody, acuity, opentable, housecall_pro, jobber, servicetitan, zocdoc.

category.description: Business type in plain words: dentist, plumber, hvac, roofing, hair salon, law firm, med spa, restaurant.

city.description: City, e.g. Atlanta, Savannah, Macon. Give city, county, zip or near.

hiring.description: Only businesses whose site says they are hiring.

minGrade.description: Email grade floor (A best). Default C.

offset.description: Skip this many, for the next page.

payments.description: Payment system on their site: yes, none, square, toast, clover, stripe, paypal.

sample.description: true = 3 free leads to judge quality (3 a day), no payment.

website.description: needs = no working website (a sales signal).

leads.description: Each lead: name, category, address, phone, website, websiteProof, email with grade, contact, socials, signals, listing

priceUsd.description: Price of this call in USD
